message.ftdungeonloot.preview: Goods: %s x %s; price: %s x %s. One shared offer per run. Right-click again after 6 ticks and within 100 ticks to confirm.
message.ftdungeonloot.too_soon: Please wait at least 6 ticks before confirming.
message.ftdungeonloot.purchased: Purchased. Your loot is in your inventory.
message.ftdungeonloot.quote_changed: The quote or run changed. Please preview again.
message.ftdungeonloot.unavailable: Unbound, invalid configuration, missing currency, or no priced goods this run.
message.ftdungeonloot.insufficient_payme: Not enough physical coins. Named coins or coins with custom NBT are not consumed.
message.ftdungeonloot.inventory_full: Not enough inventory space. Payment and stock remain unchanged.
message.ftdungeonloot.bound: Bound %s at %s to ordinary chest profile %s.
message.ftdungeonloot.new_run: Manual loot run changed for this dimension: %s. Only manual profiles are affected; ftdungeon profiles follow the entrance torch run automatically. Contents are never cleared.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_double_chest: This loot chest was merged. Keep it as a single chest to enable refilling.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_missing_prof: The ordinary chest profile, dimension, or currency is unavailable. Nothing generated.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_occupied: Old contents or an external loot table remain; no contents are overwritten.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_empty_pool: The chest loot table is missing, empty, or not chest-type. No coins generated.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_inactive_rou: The dungeon run has not started, or its API is unavailable. Nothing generated.
message.ftdungeonloot.chest_overflow: The full reward does not fit. Nothing generated.
